image.alt: Landscaping and maintenance in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: At Unidos Landscaping we design, maintain, and enhance outdoor environments for both homes and businesses. Our team provides tailored solutions that boost curb appeal, improve functionality, and increase property value. From routine maintenance to full landscape transformations, we ensure your outdoor space reflects professionalism, beauty, and long-lasting quality.

image.alt: Irrigation installation and repair in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: A healthy landscape begins with proper irrigation. We install efficient sprinkler and drip systems designed to conserve water while keeping your lawn and plants thriving. Our technicians also provide troubleshooting and repairs for leaks, broken lines, malfunctioning valves, faulty controllers, and more—ensuring your system runs smoothly year-round.

image.alt: Landscaping service calls in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: Need help fast? Our service team responds quickly to diagnose issues, make repairs, or provide on-site assessments for any landscaping or irrigation needs. Whether it’s an emergency repair, routine inspection, or unexpected problem, we’re here to get your outdoor space back in shape.

image.alt: Outdoor landscape lighting in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: Extend the usability and ambiance of your outdoor space with professionally installed landscape lighting. We design systems that highlight architectural features, illuminate walkways, enhance safety, and create a warm, inviting atmosphere. Energy-efficient LED options available for long-term performance.

Save water without sacrificing style. Our xeriscaping solutions use drought-tolerant plants, rock features, efficient irrigation, and low-maintenance design to create beautiful landscapes that thrive in dry climates. Ideal for both residential and commercial clients looking to reduce upkeep and maximize sustainability.

image.alt: Yard cleanup and seasonal enhancements in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: Refresh your landscape with seasonal cleanups and enhancements. We remove debris, trim vegetation, clear leaves, clean beds, refresh mulch or rock, and prepare your property for the upcoming season. Enhancements can include planting, landscape renovations, and design upgrades for a renewed outdoor look.

image.alt: Masonry and stonework in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: Our masonry services add durability, structure, and beauty to your outdoor environment. We specialize in walls, planters, steps, borders, fire pits, and custom stonework. Every project is crafted with precision to ensure long-lasting functionality and aesthetic appeal.

image.alt: Concrete contractor work in Albuquerque, NM

settings.editor: From walkways to patios, driveways to decorative concrete, we offer high-quality installations that elevate your landscape. Our team forms, pours, and finishes concrete with professional craftsmanship, providing durable surfaces that complement your overall design.

Enhance your outdoor space with custom paver installations. Perfect for patios, walkways, driveways, and courtyards, pavers provide both beauty and flexibility in design. We offer a wide range of colors, styles, and patterns to create a personalized, long-lasting surface.
